tools.description: Testing stage. Submit a Python program defining transform(grid) -> grid that implements the rule. It is run on every input-output pair you have seen in this trial and each miss is reported with cell coordinates. When it reproduces all of them exactly, it is run on the test input and that output is submitted as your answer. Standard library only.

tool_calls.name: propose_answer_program

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(a)
    for i in range(h):
        r=a[i]; w=len(r); j=0
        while j<w:
            if r[j]==3:
                k=j
                while k<w and r[k]==3: k+=1
                # only a run touching the right edge is movable
                if k==w:
                    n=k-j
                    p=j-1
                    while p>=0 and r[p]==0: p-=1
                    start=p+1
                    # clear original 3s
                    for x in range(j,k): r[x]=0
                    # place at the left end of the zero run if enough room
                    if start+n<=j:
                        for x in range(start,start+n): r[x]=3
                else:
                    for x in range(j,k): r[x]=0
                j=k
            else: j+=1
    return a"}
